Featured project · Greenpeace

Crowdmapping
for Recycling

Developed a crowdmapping platform for Greenpeace’s Recyclemap project, enabling volunteers to add, update and moderate recycling and ZeroWaste locations across the country.

Angular and Mapbox GL power mobile and desktop experiences. Python, PostGIS, Martin and H3 clustering process OSM data and provide scalable spatial queries for thousands of active users.

Featured project · Global aviation

Automated 300+
Airport Maps

Prepared more than 300 airport maps for airportmaps.com in only 1.5 months, meeting a demanding global production schedule.

Python scripts extracted and processed OSM and official airport POI data for terminals, entrances and roads. Automated styling reduced production time by 50%, while designers finalized accurate web maps and print-ready PDFs.
